name: Notion
title: notion.com
shortDescription: Notion is a versatile workspace that combines notes, tasks, databases, and wikis in one tool. It's designed for individuals and teams across various departments such as product management, engineering, and marketing. Users can manage projects, organize company knowledge, and automate routine tasks all within a single platform. An example use case is a startup using Notion to keep all project plans, meeting notes, and product roadmaps easily accessible and up-to-date.
cons: Can be overwhelming for new users
